description: Address critical review issues: debit race condition, webhook double-credit, Svix signature over raw body, REAL to INTEGER column change, maximum topup cap, and pending topup in history.
steps: Step 1 - Fix debitCredit race condition: Use single atomic UPDATE with WHERE balance >= amount check instead of SELECT-then-UPDATE.
Step 2 - Fix topup webhook double-credit: Add idempotency check before crediting.
Step 3 - Fix Svix signature over re-serialized JSON: Pass raw body text to verifyWebhook and use it for HMAC.
Step 4 - Fix REAL column for money: Change migrations and schema to use INTEGER.
Step 5 - Add maximum topup cap (5,000,000 IDR) in POST /topup endpoint.
Step 6 - Fix pending topup in history: Use 'topup_pending' type and filter from history.
acceptance_criteria: debitCredit uses atomic UPDATE WHERE balance >= amount
Webhook checks for existing completed topup before crediting
verifyWebhook accepts raw body string for HMAC
Migration and schema use INTEGER for balance/amount
Pending topups use 'topup_pending' type and are filtered from history
